Mission Local’s four takeaways were that turnout was 78.9%—slightly above the city’s historical presidential-election average, but well below 2020; voting patterns were sharply divided by geography, especially on Prop. K; campaign spending did not guarantee success, as the heavily funded Prop. D lost while Prop. E passed on far less money; and redistricting changed the electorate in several supervisor districts, helping some candidates and hurting others.
